projects.title: TBDB — The Biomimicry Database (Android)
projects.desc: The official Android app of The Biomimicry Database. It lets students, researchers and designers browse biological strategies on the go and turn nature's solutions into ideas for real problems. Built with Flutter and Dart, published on Google Play.

projects.title: The Biomimicry Database (Web)
projects.desc: A multimodal web platform for biomimicry research: search and explore biological strategies, connect them to design challenges and share knowledge. The flagship project behind my dissertation, combining a structured database with the VITA assistant.
